**Area:** [Graphics & text](../COVERAGE.md#graphics) · **Apple:** [CoreText](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/coretext) · **Issues:** [`area:graphics`](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aarea%3Agraphics)

## How isim implements it

- **Adapted:** isim's own implementation (`isim/frameworks/CoreText`) over fontconfig, HarfBuzz and Pango.

## API

| API / feature | Status | iOS | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CTFont` by name, size, names, metrics, character set | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: fontconfig picks the face; metrics (ascent, descent, leading, cap / x height, underline, bounding box, units per em, glyph count, slant angle) are read from that font file with HarfBuzz; `CTFontCopyName`; a UIFont works as a CTFont. Unknown names fall back to the system font; iOS font names missing on the host keep their weight/slant on the substitute (and their name). Tested (HelloCoreText, HelloQuartz) |
| `CTFontManager`: `RegisterFontsForURL` / `UnregisterFontsForURL`, `RegisterFontURLs` / `UnregisterFontURLs`, `RegisterGraphicsFont` / `UnregisterGraphicsFont`, `CreateFontDescriptorsFromData` / `FromURL`, `CreateFontDescriptorFromData`, `CTFontManagerError`, `kCTFontManagerErrorDomain`, `kCTFontManagerErrorFontURLsKey` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: fonts are added to fontconfig for this process (any scope); errors for a missing file (101), a file that is not a font (103), a second registration (105) and an unregistered font (201); the URL handler is called once, done; descriptors from data (every face of a collection) make the data usable by name without listing it among the app's fonts; unregistering only forgets a font (fontconfig cannot remove one); tested (HelloCoreText, test_coretext) |
| `CTFontCopyTable`, `CTFontCopyAvailableTables`, `CTFontTableTag` (`kCTFontTable…`), `CTFontTableOptions` | ✅ | ≤17 | passthrough: the tables of the face's file through HarfBuzz; tested (HelloCoreText) |
| `CTFontCopyVariationAxes`, `CTFontCopyVariation`, `kCTFontVariationAxis…Key` | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted: the axes of the face's `fvar` table (tag, minimum, maximum, default, name, hidden); tested (HelloCoreText, Adwaita Sans). Missing: isim draws a variable font's default instance (`kCTFontVariationAttribute` is not in isim yet), so `CTFontCopyVariation` reports the defaults |
| `CTFontCreateForString`, `CTFontCreateForStringWithLanguage` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: the font itself when it covers the start of the range, else the font the host's Pango falls back to for it; tested (HelloCoreText, emoji) |
| String attributes (`CTStringAttributes.h`): `kCTTrackingAttributeName`, `kCTLigatureAttributeName`, `kCTSuperscriptAttributeName`, `kCTUnderlineColorAttributeName`, `kCTLanguageAttributeName`, `CTUnderlineStyle`, `CTUnderlineStyleModifiers` | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted through Pango markup: tracking is letter spacing between characters; ligatures 0 turns off the standard ligatures, 2 adds discretionary ones; superscript / subscript use Pango's baseline shift and scale; the language drives shaping and fallback; tested (HelloCoreText). Missing: thick underlines and the dot / dash patterns are drawn as single solid underlines (Pango has neither) |
| `kCTStrokeWidthAttributeName`, `kCTStrokeColorAttributeName` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: the outlines of the run's glyphs stroked over the line at width percent of the font size, in the stroke color (else the foreground color); a positive width hides the fill, a negative one keeps it; tested (HelloCoreText pixels) |
| `CTFontDescriptor`, symbolic traits, font features | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: descriptors are attribute dictionaries (name, family, style name, size, traits with weight / width / slant, feature settings, file URL) resolved through fontconfig; matching descriptors list the family's installed faces (closest first; mandatory attributes filter). Traits: bold, italic, condensed / expanded set the face asked for (fontconfig synthesizes a missing bold or oblique); monospace and colour glyphs are read from the face. Glyphs, advances, bounding rects and outlines (`CTFontCreatePathForGlyph`) come from the font file (HarfBuzz), `CTFontDrawGlyphs` draws through Pango. Features: OpenType tags go to the shaper; AAT type/selector pairs map to their OpenType features (ligatures, number spacing and case, fractions, vertical position, slashed zero, case-sensitive forms, small / petite caps, contextual and swash alternates, stylistic sets); exclusive types replace earlier settings; `CTFontCopyFeatures` lists the types whose features the font has. Tested (HelloCoreText) |
| `CTLine` (create, typographic bounds, offsets/indices, truncation, draw) | 🟡 | ≤17 | laid out by Pango (HarfBuzz) at fractional positions; leading and ink bounds from the fonts; truncation by Pango's ellipsis (the truncation token is ignored); `CTLineCreateJustifiedLine` returns the line unchanged. Tested (HelloCoreText, HelloQuartz) |
| `CTRun` (glyphs, positions, advances, string indices, attributes) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: runs are Pango's glyph items (one per font, direction and attribute change) in string order; glyph ids are those of the face Pango used, and the run's `kCTFontAttributeName` is that font (a fallback font for characters the requested one lacks, the 12 pt system font when none was set); right-to-left / non-monotonic status; UTF-16 string indices; base advances and origins; metrics of the run's font; ink bounds; `CTRunDraw` of a glyph range. A line redrawn from its runs with `CTFontDrawGlyphs` matches `CTLineDraw`. `kCTRunDelegateAttributeName` (run delegates) is not supported. Tested (HelloCoreText) |
| `CTFramesetter` / `CTFrame` (frames in a path's bounding box, line origins, suggest size) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: each paragraph (ended by `\n`, `\r`, `\r\n` or U+2029) is laid out on its own with its paragraph style and isim places the lines (see `CTParagraphStyle`); rectangular paths only (bounding box). Tested (HelloCoreText, HelloQuartz) |
| `CTParagraphStyle` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: every specifier is kept and read back (`CTParagraphStyleCreateCopy`, `CTTextTab`). Frames apply alignment (natural follows the paragraph's direction), base writing direction, first-line / head / tail indents, tab stops (left, right, center, decimal: the separator centred on the stop) and the default tab interval, line break modes (word, character, clipping, truncation to one line), line height multiple / minimum / maximum, line spacing (adjustment, minimum / maximum, the deprecated fixed spacing) and paragraph spacing before / after (before applies to the first paragraph too). Lines (`CTLine`) use the tab stops and writing direction. UIKit's `NSParagraphStyle` is read the same way. Line bounds options are stored only. Tested (HelloCoreText) |
| `CTTypesetter`: `CreateWithAttributedString` (with options), `SuggestLineBreak` / `SuggestClusterBreak` (with offset), `CreateLine` (with offset); `CTFramesetterCreateWithTypesetter`, `CTFramesetterGetTypesetter` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: the paragraph from the start index laid out by Pango at the width, broken at words (characters when a word does not fit) or at grapheme clusters; a line's length includes its trailing whitespace and the paragraph separator; the offset and `kCTTypesetterOption…` are accepted and ignored; tested (HelloCoreText) |
| `CTRunDelegate`, `CTRunDelegateCallbacks`, `kCTRunDelegateAttributeName` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: each character the attribute covers takes the delegate's width, ascent and descent (a Pango shape), so lines, runs and frames make room for it, and draws nothing; the dealloc callback runs when the delegate is released; tested (HelloCoreText) |
| `CTRubyAnnotation` (`Create`, `CreateWithAttributes`, `CreateCopy`, getters), `CTRubyAlignment` / `Overhang` / `Position`, `kCTRubyAnnotationAttributeName`, `kCTRubyAnnotationSizeFactorAttributeName` | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted: `CTLineDraw` / `CTFrameDraw` draw the before (over) and after (under) ruby of each annotated range at its size factor of the base font (default 0.5), aligned start, end or centered; tested (HelloCoreText). Missing: the line's metrics leave no room for the ruby, overhang and `ScaleToFit` are ignored, inter-character and inline ruby are not drawn |
| `CTGlyphInfo` (by glyph name, glyph, character identifier; getters), `CTCharacterCollection`, `kCTGlyphInfoAttributeName`; `CTFontGetGlyphWithName`, `CTFontCopyNameForGlyph` | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted: glyph names from the font's post table / CFF charset through HarfBuzz; tested (HelloCoreText). Missing: laying out text does not substitute the glyph info's glyph |
| `CTFontCollection`: `CreateFromAvailableFonts`, `CreateWithFontDescriptors`, `CreateCopyWithFontDescriptors`, `CreateMatchingFontDescriptors` (sorted with a callback, with options), `CopyFontAttribute(s)`, `CTFontCollectionCopyOptions`, `kCTFontCollectionRemoveDuplicatesOption` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: every face fontconfig lists (by family, then PostScript name), or the faces each query descriptor matches with its name, style and traits mandatory; tested (HelloCoreText) |
| `CTLineCreateJustifiedLine`, `CTLineEnumerateCaretOffsets` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: the line laid out again by Pango, justified (the last line too) to its natural width plus the factor (at most 1) of what is missing; caret offsets are each character's leading and trailing edges in string order (a cluster's characters share them); tested (HelloCoreText) |
| `CTFrameGetFrameAttributes`, `CTFrameProgression`, `CTFramePathFillRule`, `kCTFrame…AttributeName` | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted: the frame's attributes are kept and returned; isim lays out top to bottom in the path's bounding box whatever the progression, fill rule or clipping paths |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 17 and earlier) | ❌ | ≤17 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `AnchorPoint`, `AnchorPointTable`, `AnkrTable`, `BslnFormat0Part`, `BslnFormat1Part`, `BslnFormat2Part`, `BslnFormat3Part`, `BslnFormatUnion`, `BslnTable`, `CTAdaptiveImageProviding`, `CTFontCollection`, `CTFontDescriptorMatchingState`, `CTFontManagerAutoActivationSetting`, `CTGlyphInfo`, `CTRubyAnnotation`, `CTRunDelegate`, `CTTypesetter`, `FontVariation`, `JustDirectionTable`, `JustPCAction`, `JustPCActionSubrecord`, `JustPCConditionalAddAction`, `JustPCDecompositionAction`, `JustPCDuctilityAction`, `JustPCGlyphRepeatAddAction`, `JustPostcompTable`, `JustTable`, `JustWidthDeltaEntry`, `JustWidthDeltaGroup`, `KernFormatSpecificHeader`, `KernIndexArrayHeader`, `KernKerningPair`, `KernOffsetTable`, `KernOrderedListEntry`, `KernOrderedListHeader`, `KernSimpleArrayHeader`, `KernStateEntry`, `KernStateHeader`, `KernSubtableHeader`, `KernTableHeader`, `KernVersion0Header`, `KernVersion0SubtableHeader`, `KerxAnchorPointAction`, `KerxControlPointAction`, `KerxControlPointEntry`, `KerxControlPointHeader`, `KerxCoordinateAction`, `KerxFormatSpecificHeader`, `KerxIndexArrayHeader`, `KerxKerningPair`, `KerxOrderedListEntry`, `KerxOrderedListHeader`, `KerxSimpleArrayHeader`, `KerxStateEntry` and 69 more (126 types; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
